# `ironwood.pool`

**Package reference**

Explicitly built, reusable object pools.

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`ArrayObjectPool`](ArrayObjectPool.md) | class | Reuses objects in a resizable array with configurable preloading and growth. |
| [`MultiArrayObjectPool`](MultiArrayObjectPool.md) | class | Reuses objects across linked array segments without copying existing slots. |
| [`ObjectBuilder`](ObjectBuilder.md) | interface | Creates independent objects for an owning pool. |
| [`ObjectPool`](ObjectPool.md) | interface | Owns reusable objects and lends them to callers through [`get()`](ObjectPool.md#member-get-28--29-). |
